messages:
zoe: QA flagged nondeterministic token ordering when using sdk-js 2.5.0 with runtime 3.1.x on llama3q, reproducible at batch_size>32. No errors, but ranking diffs in e2e tests.

sam: When did 2.5.0 publish? Any customer hits yet?

mira: Published yesterday. Internal regression tests started failing; not widespread to customers but could affect result ordering.

jin: Local repro confirmed. Looks like a change in serialization affecting float->int rounding in the SDK helper.

zoe: Proposal: apply a scoped SDK pin to 2.4.8 for routes hitting model_family==llama3q in regions [eu-west, hosted], leave dedicated-us as canary. Schedule a canary unpin next week.

deploy-bot: Audit: sdk-js 2.5.0 published at 2026-03-20T10:02Z. No current pins.

sam: Region-scoped pin sounds right. Release-coordinator, prep a change-window blurb and short release-note entry.

release-coordinator: I'll draft: "Scoped SDK pin to 2.4.8 for llama3q traffic due to serialization regression in 2.5.0; canary unpin scheduled 2026-03-25."

oncall-eng: Running smoke suite against eu-west with 2.5.0 now (batch_size=64, seq_len=1024). ETA 8m.

oncall-eng: Smoke diff: ```diff
- expected_top3: ["A","B","C"]
+ observed_top3: ["B","A","C"]
```

jin: Matches my local run. I'll patch 2.5.1 with a small serialization fix and unit tests.

zoe: deploy-bot, can you add pin selector and report propagation id?

deploy-bot: Action queued: sdk_pin version=2.4.8 selector="model_family==llama3q && region in (eu-west, hosted)" reason="serialization regression in sdk-js 2.5.0" requested_by=@zoe. Propagation id=pin-1721002468-01.

deploy-bot: Action completed: pin applied.

sam: Good. Keep pin until 2.5.1 validated. Staged unpin plan: canary dedicated-us -> staggered eu-west -> global. Rollback path: re-apply selector pin and route to 2.4.8.

mira: Update support playbook with reproduction steps and failing prompt set; add alert threshold for top-k flip rate >0.5%.

jin: PR for 2.5.1 incoming, requesting review.

oncall-eng: After pin, llama3q traffic routed to hosted; latency up ~8% but acceptable.

release-coordinator: Change window CW-2026-03-25-llama3q-sdk-unpin created and linked to this thread.

zoe: I'll close when 2.5.1 deploy and canary pass. Thanks all.
